scripts.install-reqs: cd frontend && npm install && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently "npm run dev:sidecar" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run electron:start"
scripts.dev:sidecar: cd backend && uv run python -m texthunter
scripts.electron:start: wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development tsx electron/main.ts
scripts.build: npm run generate:sdk && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron:compile && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:sidecar-winos && npm run build
scripts.clean: Remove-Item -Recurse -Force release, frontend/dist, backend/dist, electron/*.js, electron/*.d.ts -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
